channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: A Gentleman's Guide to Love and Murder at UWF (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Fri 11/6, Sat 11/7, Fri 11/13, Sat 11/14 at 7:30 PM · Sun 11/8 and Sun 11/15 at 2:30 PM | Besser Studio Theatre, UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts | No published price. UWF Theatre stages the Tony-winning musical comedy about a poor young man who plots his way past the relatives ahead of him in line for an earldom. There are four evening shows at 7:30 PM and two Sunday matinees at 2:30 PM. UWF says adult situations and subject matter may make the show inappropriate for some audiences.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Nov 24 · mostly 2 PM to 6 PM, 2 PM to 5 PM from Nov 16 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Finding Neverland at Joe Jefferson Playhouse (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Fridays and Saturdays 7:30 PM · Sundays 2:30 PM | Joe Jefferson Playhouse | from $26.75. Joe Jefferson Players stage Finding Neverland, the musical about playwright J.M. Barrie and how he came to write Peter Pan. Shows run three weekends, Friday and Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons. Tickets are $26.75.

item.title: Frank Brown International Songwriters' Festival (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Thu 11/5 to Sun 11/15 · times vary by stage | Flora-Bama Lounge and more than two dozen stages along the Gulf Coast | No published price. More than 200 songwriters play over 600 performances on more than two dozen stages along the Florida and Alabama Gulf Coast during this 11-day festival, which grew out of the Flora-Bama on Perdido Key. Songwriters tell the stories behind their songs, from Grammy winners to rising talent. Many shows are free, and some are ticketed or charge a cover.

item.title: Guys and Dolls at Stage Crafters (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Fri 11/6 to Sun 11/15 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM | Stage Crafters Theatre | from $32. Stage Crafters stages the Damon Runyon musical comedy Guys and Dolls over two weekends in November. Gambler Nathan Detroit hunts for cash to run the biggest craps game in New York while his fiancee Adelaide waits out a fourteen-year engagement. The company bills itself as Florida's oldest all-volunteer community theatre, now in its 54th year.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Mahjong at the Mansion at Bragg-Mitchell (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesday 11/10 · Tuesday 11/17 · time not posted | Bragg-Mitchell Mansion | No published price. The Bragg-Mitchell Mansion in Mobile hosts Mahjong at the Mansion on Tuesday November 10 and Tuesday November 17. The mansion's home page lists the two dates with a registration link. It prints no start time and no price.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Pilates and Pumpkins at Holland Farms (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Friday 11/6 · 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM · Sunday 11/15 · 4:15 PM to 5:15 PM | Holland Farms | from $20. Holland Farms holds two more Pilates and Pumpkins classes on the farm in November. The Friday November 6 session runs from 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM, and the Sunday November 15 session runs from 4:15 PM to 5:15 PM. The class is $20 a person, bought online by date. All sales are final.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Qigong classes at Historic Blakeley (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM · Saturday 11/21 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM | Historic Blakeley State Park | from $10. Historic Blakeley State Park offers guided Qigong, a slow, low-impact practice that combines movement, deep breathing and visualization and is described as an ancestor of Tai Chi. Classes run from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Saturday 11/7 and Saturday 11/21, with an optional group hike afterward. They take place rain or shine unless there is lightning or severe weather.

item.title: Story Time and Craft at Foley Community Library (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM · Saturdays 10:00 AM | Foley Community Library | No published price. The Foley Community Library holds a story time with a craft every Tuesday and Saturday from August through May. Tuesday sessions run at 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM, and the Saturday session runs at 10:00 AM. No age limit or price is posted.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (TUE 11/10)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (TUE 11/10)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (TUE 11/10)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Stretch & Flow Yoga (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. This Vinyasa-style yoga class blends longer intentional holds with gentle flow to build flexibility and release tension. It meets for an hour first thing in the morning at the Niceville Senior Center. The center requests a $3 donation for the class, on top of its usual access rates.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (TUE 11/10)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Namaste by the Bay free community yoga at Waterfront Park (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Saturday 9:00 AM | Orange Beach Waterfront Park | Free. Orange Beach Parks and Recreation runs free community yoga by the water on Saturday mornings from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM, with a different instructor each week. All ages and levels are welcome. The November sessions fall on 11/7, 11/14, 11/21 and 11/28.

item.title: Party Bridge (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This game at the Niceville Senior Center is built for seasoned players rather than beginners. Players call the Senior Center's bridge organizer to reserve a seat, so spots are not first come, first served. It runs Tuesday mornings into early afternoon.

item.title: Teen Quiet / Study Day (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM · through 11/24 | Niceville Public Library, Teen Space | Free. The Niceville Public Library sets aside its Teen Space as a quiet study day, open from 9 AM to 6 PM. Admission is free, and the room is meant for teens who need a place to read, work or study without the usual noise. The city calendar lists it every Tuesday through November 24.

item.title: Chair Yoga (TUE 11/10)
item.description: 9:45 AM to 10:45 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. This Chair Yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center mixes seated poses with supported standing work. It aims at posture, flexibility, core strength, joint mobility, balance, stability and stress reduction. It asks a $3 donation and repeats every Tuesday and Thursday morning, for members age 55 and up.

item.title: Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/9 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home is a special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art that draws on the artist's historical research, folklore and personal narrative. The museum describes it as a visual memoir of her life and a tableau of the African American experience. It stays open through January 9, 2027.

item.title: Gateway: From Graffiti to Gallery at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, through 9/1/2027 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. The Mobile Museum of Art traces how artists who started with graffiti in New York's subways moved into galleries, with work by Basquiat, Haring, Scharf, KAWS and Banksy from the Masterworks Foundation collection. The show runs a full year, Tuesday through Saturday. Mobile County residents get in free on Thursdays.

item.title: Good Listener's Storytime at Parkway (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM · through 12/29 | Parkway Branch Library | No published price. Parkway Branch Library runs a storytime built for listening, with stories, rhyming games, and crafts, aimed at children ages 3 to 7. The library asks that groups register ahead of time, though individual families are not required to. It repeats every Tuesday through December 29.

item.title: Handle with Care at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 3/27 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Handle with Care is an interactive special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art. Artists Calder Kamin of Austin and Jacob Reptile of New Orleans turn trash into soft, complex sculptures that visitors move through as an environment. It stays open through March 27, 2027.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.

item.title: Next Generation Homeschool Art: Ages 7-9, Tuesday Mornings (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Pensacola Museum of Art: Classroom | from $180. Next Generation Homeschool Art is a visual arts course for ages 7 to 9 that follows National Visual Arts Standards. Group A meets Tuesday mornings from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Pensacola Museum of Art, taught by Marce Wagner, known as Ms. Messy. Term 2 runs October 20 through December 15 with no class Thanksgiving week, and costs $160 for museum members or $180 for non-members. Three other weekday groups are available for different ages and schedules.

item.title: Orange Beach Library Storytime: Confirmed September Dates (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM · through 12/8 | Orange Beach Public Library | No published price. The Orange Beach Public Library hosts a caregiver and child storytime on Tuesday mornings from 10 AM to 10:30 AM. The half hour combines books, songs, puppets and bubbles, and wraps up with a themed craft. It runs weekly through December 8.

item.title: Read & Play Storytime (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library: Youth Programming Room | No published price. Ben May Main Library's Read & Play Storytime combines books, songs, and fingerplays for babies and toddlers alongside a caregiver. The library says it is best suited for ages 0 to 3 and is built to support sensory, listening, and memory development. It repeats every Tuesday, including November 3, 10 and 17.

item.title: Timeless Hats by Susie Mae Pugh-Williams at the Mobile Museum of Art (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/30 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Timeless Hats is a special exhibition of more than two dozen hats at the Mobile Museum of Art. Some were made by Mrs. Williams, and others are hats she admired and drew inspiration from for her own creations. It stays open through January 30, 2027.

item.title: Words with Friends (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Despite the name, this Niceville Senior Center program is a writing and sharing group, not a session of the mobile word game. Participants work from simple prompts and writing exercises, then read their stories aloud, and the city says no writing experience is required. It meets Tuesday mornings.

item.title: Children: Lap Babies Storytime (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM | Daphne Public Library | No published price. Daphne Public Library hosts a storytime for lap babies, Tuesday from 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Tuesday sessions in November fall on the 3rd, 10th and 17th at this same time.

item.title: Craft & Chat @ the Library (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Second and fourth Tuesday of the month · 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM · through 12/22 | Niceville Public Library | No published price. Niceville Public Library hosts Craft & Chat on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month, a two-hour gathering for crafting and conversation. Bring your latest project; the Friends of the Niceville Library provide treats, and you are welcome to pack a sack lunch.

item.title: Decorate with Us at Quayside Art Gallery (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Daily through 11/16 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Quayside Art Gallery | No published price. Quayside Art Gallery in Pensacola's historic district turns its first floor into a set of home style living spaces to show how local art fits a room. The show highlights all of the gallery's artists, with work ranging from large paintings and photography to pottery, glass, jewelry and wooden inlaid furniture. It is aimed at decorators, designers, realtors and condo owners, though anyone can walk in.

item.title: Game Day on The Green at Portside on Main (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Saturdays 11/7, 11/14 and 11/21 · 11:00 AM | Portside on Main, The Wharf | No published price. The Wharf in Orange Beach lists Game Day on The Green at Portside on three November Saturdays, the 7th, 14th and 21st, each at 11:00 AM. The calendar prints no description or price, so the day works as a drop-in for college football on the lawn.

item.title: Preschool Storytime at Jay Library (TUE 11/10)
item.description: Tuesdays · 11 AM-11:30 AM, through 12/1 | Jay Library | No published price. Preschool Storytime is a weekly storytime for preschoolers at Jay Library, 5259 Booker Ln., part of the Santa Rosa County Library System. It runs 11-11:30 AM on Tuesdays from Oct 6 through Dec 1.

item.title: Seated Zumba Gold (TUE 11/10)
item.description: 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. Seated Zumba Gold is a chair-based dance-fitness class for members who use a wheelchair or live with limited mobility or balance concerns, set to lively music. It asks a $3 donation every Tuesday and Thursday late morning. The class is part of the Niceville Senior Center's programming for members age 55 and up.
